note: The PR-7 gate conversations as user messages. Conversations 1 to 30 are the gate: TestConversations proves the deterministic half offline, and the catalog-only bar counts these alone. Conversations marked "probe" do not count toward the verdict. They exist to find catalog gaps, so they hold the shapes the gate set never takes: a user who changes their mind, contradicts themselves, asks a question back, or wants something the app can not serve. Their questions still reach the M-5 sheet (D-96). Conversations 53 to 66 are the terse set (D-105). Their users never repeat a value they already gave, so a redundant question strands the conversation instead of getting an answer. Every gate conversation before them restates the format at turn 2, which hid that defect and let both bars reward it. The terse set counts as probes, so the catalog-only bar stays comparable to runs 1 to 13. Conversations 67 to 100 joined on 2026-08-26 (D-145). They are terse like 53 to 66, and they take the shapes the first 66 never took: bracket 1 and bracket 5, five colors and no colors, a companion, a Background pair, a corrected card name, a corrected color, a zero budget, a partial proxy, a per-card cap beside a total cap, a collection of lands alone, a library that does not exist, Pauper Commander, Oathbreaker, Historic, and a user who answers with a bare digit. They count as probes, so the catalog-only bar still reads the first 30.
